author: agent
log: Names are rule-generated by a script (colour of the largest island/component from its top colour share, shape from size ratios, position from at, dimensions in the name from size). No function (what the thing is) is claimed anywhere: the evidence has no semantic cue except material words light, glass and ColorEffectR57G8B136 (read as a purple), used for Single_Triangle_Light_Facet, Dark_Glass_Small_Block and Small_Purple_Cube.

Material names such as VMtl01..08, _22jyj, eref, efefefefef, l__l, _1111111 are opaque; they carry no function, so were not used except to confirm that meshes sharing a material and structure are copies.

Dimension tokens in names (2-decimal, p = decimal point) are mesh-local island sizes; mesh-local scales differ wildly between meshes (0.1 to 160), so sizes cannot be compared across meshes and I could not tell which meshes belong to the same authored object. One group per mesh because grouping meshes into objects is not supported by the evidence.

Many meshes are identical copies (same triangles, size, colour; only the at-offsets swapped on x/z, i.e. rotated 90 degrees). Uniqueness was forced with ordinal suffixes (_Second, _Third ...); those suffixes carry no meaning and are the only thing separating the copies.

Thin-plate meshes (islands of 2 or 4 triangles, one coplanar pair duplicated, e.g. 4t pairs with identical size and at) look like double-sided panels or box shells; I merged them as one whole part because the evidence does not separate objects inside them. Whole-mesh abstention for all meshes with 20 or more islands and for all meshes with more than 5 components (hundreds of tiny islands; component grain gives sub-millimetre sizes).

Component grain meshes with 2-5 components were cut to one part per component: the largest is Main_Body_Cluster, the rest are named by shape (Upright_Rod/Flat_Piece/Small_Piece) and by left/right, low/high, LowZ/HighZ from at. LowZ/HighZ is used because the evidence does not say which of z is front.
Meshes 5 and 21 were split by island: island 0 (flat, low, widest) vs islands 1-4 (smaller, higher); this is size/position only.
Untextured 12-triangle meshes (no uv, no texture) have no colour evidence at all; named Untextured_Box_<dims> only.

Sizes in the report mix frames: island sizes are mesh-local (up to 166) while component sizes are world frame (~0.01-0.1); a component-grain mesh and an island-grain mesh of the same object therefore show 100x different size numbers, which made cross-mesh matching of copies unreliable.
The describe text for colours lists at most three palette entries; with 2-colour texture atlases (many islands 40-90% one dark red or near-black) colour gives little to separate parts.
